commands.label: Duplicate view
commands.purpose: Create another independent Surface instance with the selected bindings.
commands.consequence: Creates one new view; it does not create a runtime or copy resource truth.

agent.label: Agent runtime needs attention
agent.detail: The scientific workbench remains available while Agent dependencies are repaired.

definition.label: New Agent conversation
definition.purpose: Start an independent Agent conversation for the active project.
definition.consequence: Creates conversation state only after Agent runtime admission succeeds.

availability.reason: The Agent runtime is not ready.

definition.label: Search commands
definition.purpose: Find every command registered for the current project and context.
definition.consequence: Opens command search without executing a command.

definition.label: Open project
definition.purpose: Choose and activate a local Rho project.
definition.consequence: Requests a project switch through the existing project transition gate.

definition.label: Interrupt active operation
definition.purpose: Interrupt a running scientific operation in the active project.
definition.consequence: Requests cancellation through the operation's existing broker-owned lane.

definition.label: Restart Workspace R
definition.purpose: Recover or replace the authoritative Workspace R process.
definition.consequence: Requests a supervised Workspace R restart; open Surfaces do not restart it implicitly.

definition.label: Inspect fixture
definition.purpose: Inspect the selected fixture through a workspace plugin.
definition.consequence: Runs this workspace plugin command through broker admission.

availability.reason: The fixture plugin host is unavailable.
